authorization: User explicitly authorized implementation and Metis execution after adversarial review on 2026-10-18.
historical_boundaries: No change to E04/E07, original arrays, original thresholds or scientific claim status. This new target does not replace the historical canonical forecast task.

data.exposure: Previously inspected development data; never described as an untouched confirmation set
data.target_qc: All finite realized Patv, including zero/negative net export; no pitch/state filtering
data.pitch_diagnostic: Mean of all three finite raw blade angles; continuous degree-valued measurement, not a wind-threshold state label
data.clock: Synthetic event-end and release clock, not observed field telemetry logs

task.point_forecaster: Preset squared-error histogram boosting from wind/power history only, published six steps before reserve issue; predicts twelve steps after publication
task.population: All finite future net-export targets on registered coordinates, independent of pitch availability
task.scope: Turbine-level risk-screening surrogate conditional on a synthetic legally earlier common forecast; no PCC procurement or storage-deliverability claim

temporal_rule: Each fit/calibration issue range ends early enough that its final target plus one release step precedes the next stage. Histories may use earlier already-arrived observations.
common_information: Published forecast value, issue clock sine/cosine and turbine ID; all candidates receive the same commitment. A also receives arrived wind history and pitch history only when the condition permits it.
restricted_reference: WindBins intentionally uses only last-arrived wind and global missing fallback. It is not an equal-input complexity control and cannot establish pure representation value.
representation: Three identical preset tabular regressors trained on an earlier disjoint historical stage: wind-only pitch regression, full-consequence pitch regression and full-consequence regression with a newly derived training-label permutation. No graph or MoE added.
training_privilege: Historical continuous pitch supervision is explicitly allowed. Deployment pitch withheld only in the named condition. This is not a pitch-never-recorded claim.
probe_naming: C_WindScore/state_wind are legacy identifiers for the base-information probe: A includes pitch history under fresh/delayed conditions; only under pitch_withheld is the telemetry wind-only. No hidden-state recovery claim in pitch-observed conditions.

learner.missing_preprocessing: SimpleImputer constant zero with add_indicator=True and keep_empty_features=True, fit only on the corresponding historical fit stage. Added after v1 remote preflight caught sklearn1.9 all-NaN column failure; no v1 model results produced.
learner.subsampling: One archived shared set of policy-fit sample indices per seed; no evaluation-based selection

calibration: One global signed Q0.90(shortfall-max(raw reserve,0)) offset, fitted only on the calibration stage; final action=max(raw reserve+offset,0). Report both raw and calibrated accounting; no risk-certification assumption.

inference.estimand: Mean kWh-equivalent loss per valid turbine interval, conditional on the five archived instances
inference.blocks: Natural WTB index days; all turbines/candidates/conditions share temporal resampling
inference.multiplicity: Primary family is all 42 loss comparisons at the three-day block span. Bonferroni percentile intervals are approximate development intervals only; other metrics/spans are descriptive sensitivities, not additional certified families.
inference.safety_status: No empirical confidence certification; original E04 no-feasible result remains unchanged

confirmation.status: Independent new data and practical effect specification still required
